no_adcom_quote.quote: This application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee because fesoterodine fumarate is a member of the anti-muscarinic class of products used to treat overactive bladder, including previously approved products. Fesoterodine fumarate did not pose unique concerns beyond those applicable to other members of this class.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for TOVIAZ (fesoterodine fumarate, NDA022030). The Summary Review and Office/Division Director memo both explicitly state the application was not referred to an FDA advisory committee, because fesoterodine is an anti-muscarinic for overactive bladder in the same class as previously approved products and posed no unique concerns. With no AdComm meeting held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
